messages.content:
需求：前后端：替换为 page/page_size，均为整数；page ≥1，缺省 1；page_size 为 1—50，缺省 20；内部偏移为 `(page-1)*page_size`。请求只要包含 skip 或 limit 即返回 422，不接受双协议。

持续有效约束：响应仍为 data/count；权限与排序不变。page 超出末页得到空 data 和真实 count；前端页码从 1 开始。

本次变更事实：
[FACT:request-skip-accepted] request.skip.accepted = false
[FACT:request-limit-accepted] request.limit.accepted = false
[FACT:request-page-type] request.page.type = "integer"
[FACT:request-page-minimum] request.page.minimum = 1
[FACT:request-page-default] request.page.default = 1
[FACT:request-page-size-type] request.page_size.type = "integer"
[FACT:request-page-size-minimum] request.page_size.minimum = 1
[FACT:request-page-size-maximum] request.page_size.maximum = 50
[FACT:request-page-size-default] request.page_size.default = 20
[FACT:pagination-offset] pagination.offset = "(page-1)*page_size"

当前契约事实：
[FACT:request-invalid-status] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.invalid_status = 422
[FACT:response-count-scope] (frontend,backend; derivable) response.count.scope = "authorized_filtered_before_pagination"
[FACT:response-empty-page-data] (frontend,backend; derivable) response.empty_page.data = []
[FACT:request-skip-accepted] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.skip.accepted = false
[FACT:request-limit-accepted] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.limit.accepted = false
[FACT:request-page-type] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page.type = "integer"
[FACT:request-page-minimum] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page.minimum = 1
[FACT:request-page-default] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page.default = 1
[FACT:request-page-size-type] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page_size.type = "integer"
[FACT:request-page-size-minimum] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page_size.minimum = 1
[FACT:request-page-size-maximum] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page_size.maximum = 50
[FACT:request-page-size-default] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page_size.default = 20
[FACT:pagination-offset] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) pagination.offset = "(page-1)*page_size"
